## About
Cardinal Garden Center is owned and operated by the Mellusi family. We are a full service garden center with a wide selection of plants, products, tools and supplies for all of your gardening needs.
Nearly everything sold in garden centers can be found at Cardinal's, along with helpful information on how to properly use those products. When you need information, we take the time to give it to you. When you're short on time and need a quick purchase, we make your time a priority.
We keep our display space tight and pick only quality products that we ourselves would be proud to use.

## Services
- Plants: A wide selection of plants for your yard, garden and porch, along with the products, tools and supplies to care for them.
- Potting soil: Potting soil and drainage rock for your containers. One reviewer called our potting soil top-notch.
- Pots: One reviewer said our selection of pots was much better than the local big box stores.
- Frazier and Balsam Firs: One reviewer found our firs very fresh and full.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open all year?
A: No. We close for the winter, and our hours change through the seasons, so please check online for our current hours.

Q: Can I order plants without coming in?
A: One customer chose plants over the phone and had them picked up by courier. Give us a call to talk it through.

Q: How do I hear about sales?
A: Fill out the form on our contact page and we'll let you know by email when merchandise is on sale.

## What customers say
- "I wanted to take a moment to give a shout out to one of my favorite new local businesses.. I tracked down Cardinal garden center after seeing a delivery of beautiful laurel plants arrive at my neighbor’s house while I was out on a walk. I immediately knew I wanted to buy my plants at Cardinal because they were of such obvious high quality. Not only do they have lovely plants, but the staff is helpful, knowledgeable and just basically awesome. I’m new to the northeast so they spent plenty of time discussing my new yard’s many landscaping needs and walking me through their inventory. They also have an excellent selection of pots—much better than the local big box stores. On my first visit they helped me choose two large planters for a pair of enormous Boston ferns along with drainage rocks and top-notch potting soil. I also purchased a gorgeous pair of mums for my front porch and a set of boxwoods to later replace the mums. On a recent visit, I found the most beautiful carving pumpkins and a couple of cute decorative ones. Have you watched the movie “”You’ve Got Mail.” A visit to Cardinal is like stopping by “”The Shop Around the Corner.” You receive plenty of personalized service from a knowledgeable staff.

I stopped by Cardinal this morning and discovered a wonderful selection of Frazier and Balsam Firs. They were very fresh and full. I also picked up a beautiful wreath." (J. Bustillo, 5/5)
- "I ordered four plants and had them picked up via courier. The person I spoke to on the phone was knowledgeable, patient, and flexible as I tried to figure out which ones I wanted without actually visiting the nursery. The plants are in amazing shape, and they’re all a good size for their price." (Arielle Waller, 5/5)
